units.source_text: 他裹在白衬衫里的腹部在起伏，摇曳在上面的透过叶缝投射下来的阳光，使我得到了幸福。

en.t: His abdomen, wrapped in a white shirt, rose and fell, and the sunlight filtering through the leaves and wavering over it gave me happiness.

units.source_text: 我的人生激起了波澜，犹如这家伙的衬衫的皱纹。

en.t: Ripples stirred through my life, like the wrinkles in this fellow's shirt.

units.source_text: 但是，这衬衫多么洁白耀眼啊！

en.t: But how dazzlingly white this shirt was!

units.source_text: 所起的皱纹依然……说不定我也？……

en.t: The wrinkles that had formed still remained... perhaps I, too?...
